About playback

YouTube search uses the server-side YouTube Data API key configured on Vercel. Videos open in the visible official YouTube player, which may contain ads. YouTube does not allow our app to download its videos, remove ads, or keep the embed playing while your screen is off.

For an ad-free experience with possible screen-off controls, use the Import my audio button for songs you own or are licensed to play. Those audio files are not sent to a server and disappear from the list when the tab reloads.
